method: Selected internationally reported or officially announced changes; separate facts from potential Kazakhstan effects

records.title: EU adopts extensive new sanctions listings targeting Russia's military-industrial supply chains

other_sources.label: Associated Press report
other_sources.role: Independent news reporting; final legal text and implementation require verification

records.summary: News reports describe the EU adopting nearly 1,600 additional sanctions listings connected with Russia's military-industrial supply chains. Exact legal obligations and affected persons/entities require checking the EU's operative instruments.
records.reason: Potential sanctions-compliance, finance, payment, trade diversion and Russian input-supply exposure for Kazakhstan companies; Kazakhstan-specific effects have not been demonstrated.
records.status: Multi-outlet reporting; EU legal instruments not inspected

exposure_channels.name: Sanctions compliance and payments
exposure_channels.mechanism: Kazakhstan financial institutions and firms with counterparties named in measures may face new compliance or transaction constraints.

exposure_channels.name: Trade and supply inputs
exposure_channels.mechanism: Russian intermediate goods and logistics links could face additional scrutiny if covered by the measures.

records.title: European Commission selects 46 strategic critical raw material projects

other_sources.label: EU selected project register
other_sources.role: European Commission selected strategic projects register

records.summary: The European Commission selected 46 projects in 16 EU member states for Strategic Project status under the Critical Raw Materials Act. Selection can ease permitting and financing access but does not establish that projects are operational or fully financed.
records.reason: Future EU mining and processing capacity may alter buyers, investment incentives and competitive conditions for Kazakhstan's mineral exports and downstream industrial plans.
records.status: Official European Commission announcement; Kazakhstan market effects hypothetical

exposure_channels.name: Critical minerals competition
exposure_channels.mechanism: Additional EU processing capacity may change mineral demand and offtake patterns relative to Kazakhstan's production.

exposure_channels.name: Investment and processing incentives
exposure_channels.mechanism: EU policy support could alter where downstream mineral refining investment is located.

records.title: EU and China announce preliminary arrangement on hybrid vehicle trade
records.summary: EU and China reported a preliminary trade arrangement following consultations on market access and hybrid vehicle exports. Its final approval, legal force and details are not established by the preliminary announcement.
records.reason: Possible indirect trade diversion, automotive manufacturing competition, intermediate-input demand, and China–EU supply-chain shifts relevant to Kazakhstan; magnitude unknown.
records.status: Preliminary announcement reported; not yet implemented binding rules

exposure_channels.name: Automotive trade diversion
exposure_channels.mechanism: Changed China–EU access, if implemented, could redirect vehicle exports or related investment through other markets including Central Asia.

records.title: Workers begin strike at Chile's Centinela copper mine after contract negotiations fail
records.summary: Reuters reports that workers at Centinela copper mine in Chile began a strike after labour negotiations failed. Mine-specific production effects and duration require further verification.
records.reason: Copper supply disruption in a major producer may affect international copper prices and competition for Kazakhstan copper producers, depending on outage duration and wider supply-demand balance.
records.status: Reuters reported strike; Kazakhstan price/revenue effect not measured

exposure_channels.name: Global copper supply and price
exposure_channels.mechanism: Sustained disruption could reduce traded copper supply and raise prices that affect Kazakhstan producers and downstream users.

records.title: Indonesia inaugurates new nickel, battery and industrial facilities at Weda Bay
records.summary: Reuters reports the Indonesian government unveiling nickel, battery, solar and aluminium-related investments and facilities at Weda Bay. Some operations started while other facilities remain projects under construction; announcement values do not equal realized production.
records.reason: Expansion of Asian critical-mineral processing capacity may change mineral prices, sourcing and competitive conditions for Kazakhstan's mining and manufacturing investment.
records.status: Reported industrial inaugurations; future production and Kazakhstan implications unverified

exposure_channels.name: Nickel and battery processing competition
exposure_channels.mechanism: New refining and industrial capacity could shift regional offtake terms and processing investment opportunities.

records.title: India introduces new foreign-exchange derivative hedging restrictions
records.summary: Reuters reports Indian central bank measures that tighten banks' treatment of currency hedge positions, increasing costs for some importers. Precise operative rules and market responses require the Reserve Bank of India's original circular.
records.reason: Could indicate broader emerging-market foreign-exchange and funding conditions, but a Kazakhstan transmission would require observed portfolio flows, currency and interest-rate channels.
records.status: Single publisher report; specific RBI instrument not yet inspected

exposure_channels.name: Emerging-market financial conditions
exposure_channels.mechanism: If investors repriced peer emerging-market currency risk, Kazakhstan FX and financing markets might face spillovers; no evidence of such spillovers yet.

records.title: DR Congo begins new geological survey to support mineral exploration
records.summary: DR Congo's geological agency launched a new national airborne mapping survey intended to improve information for mineral exploration and future investment. This is a research and prospecting initiative, not evidence of new mineral output.
records.reason: More reliable geological information could improve competing mineral investment opportunities; Kazakhstan investment competition is hypothetical and would occur over years, not weeks.
records.status: Reuters reports survey launch; domestic Kazakhstan effects speculative

exposure_channels.name: Mining investment competition
exposure_channels.mechanism: Additional geological data may change the distribution of global exploration capital, but no investor diversion from Kazakhstan has been observed.
